entries.title: Request redistribution licenses from GitHub shot-dataset owners
entries.rationale: Redistribution and third-party consent require rights-holder responses; source-license research and catalog updates are separate executable work.

prerequisites.name: Named authorized outreach owner and source-specific contact records
Explicit data licenses and player-consent confirmation where needed

acceptance: Preserve the original prioritized owner/study outreach list and track licensed, declined or no-response outcomes after a stated waiting period.
Bind any changed redistribution status to actual permissions and refreshed source identities; reference-only data remains restricted.

entries.title: Epic: Public launch-monitor evidence and model-comparison database
entries.rationale: The next matched-shot evidence stage depends on the private Release B collection campaign and explicit source rights.

prerequisites.name: Authorized native paired-device exports supplied through the owning campaign
Verified rights, calibration/firmware/environment identity and group-safe acquisition metadata

acceptance: Keep immutable native bytes and lineage; do not manufacture shot-level data from aggregates.
Use group-safe matched shots for bias/MAE/RMSE/calibration and physical-residual baselines before neural models.
Keep the public contract/facade fail-closed until the owning campaign qualifies its evidence.
